blocks.answers: Model rewrite (from the lesson): 'JazakAllahu khayran for sharing. The Hanafi school does not raise the hands here, based on its evidence; the Shafi'i and Hanbali schools do. Both are followed by great scholars.' Each rewrite: evidence, gentle words, good opinion of others, respect for both views (these are acceptable differences).

keywords.def: an issue where qualified scholars can differ

questions.q: Explain what the story of Asr at Banu Qurayzah teaches about differing.
questions.a: Both groups tried to obey; the Prophet ﷺ did not blame either, so honest difference in understanding is accepted.

questions.q: Online forum rewrite on the pupil PDF: three harsh replies (example posts) about raising hands, Amin aloud and hands on the chest. Rewrite each with adab: evidence, gentleness and respect.
questions.a: Rewritten replies using evidence, gentle words, good opinion of others

questions.q: Extend: why does difference in fiqh not split the ummah if handled well?
questions.a: It is a mercy and flexibility; unity is on the fundamentals.

questions.q: Stretch: when should a Muslim not follow a 'different opinion'?
questions.a: When it contradicts a clear text or ijma', or is from someone unqualified.

options: Where to place the hands in salah
questions.a: A) Where to place the hands in salah. Hand placement is an ijtihadi matter; the others are fixed by clear texts and ijma'.

questions.q: Who blamed neither group at Banu Qurayzah?
Think again: should the friends argue?
questions.a: No: it is a valid difference; respect each other.
